priorityList: Use Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting.
Use Howling Blast if Frost Fever is not ticking or if a Rime proc is active.
Use Remorseless Winter on cooldown, or when Gathering Storm is at 10 stacks.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring it is used when you are ready to spend resources.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa (if talented) while Pillar of Frost is active and Runic Power is above 60.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost or Breath of Sindragosa, ideally at the end of the Pillar duration.
Spend Killing Machine procs on Frostscythe if there are 3 or more targets.
Spend Killing Machine procs on Obliterate if Frostscythe is not used, prioritizing targets with the Trollbane slow debuff.
Use Howling Blast on any Rime proc that occurs.
Cast Glacial Advance to spend Runic Power in AoE scenarios.
Cast Frost Strike on targets with 5 stacks of Razorice if Shattering Blade is talented and you are not pooling Runic Power.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if runes are low (less than 2), if you lack Killing Machine procs, or to sustain Breath of Sindragosa.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials (like Blood Fury or Berserking) during Pillar of Frost.
Cast Raise Dead on cooldown for extra damage.
Use Obliterate as a filler to generate Runic Power when not in Pillar of Frost or when runes are floating high.
